t: You're looking at a sculpture of Saint John the Baptist by Hans Feibusch. Feibusch was a German artist of Jewish heritage who lived and worked in Britain from 1933 until his death. He is best known for his murals, especially in Anglican churches. He worked in thirty of them, which is probably the largest body of work of its kind by any artist in the history of the Church of England. So this sculpture is a piece by someone far better known for painting on walls.
